column3: “standing firm” renders “to make firm”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Cross again to the ark” renders “Pass over before the ark.”
“the sons of Reuben” renders “the descendants of Reuben.”
NASB does not render the closing “saying.”
“as before” renders “as yesterday and three days ago.”
“on the eastern edge of Jericho” renders “on the edge of the east of Jericho.”
“the Red Sea” renders “the Sea of Reeds.”
